title.zh: 【Lido 工程负责人：Glamsterdam 硬分叉期间存在质押存款劫持风险】
title.en: 【Lido 工程负责人：Glamsterdam 硬分叉期间存在质押存款劫持风险】

current_state.zh: Lido's engineering lead warned that during Ethereum's Glamsterdam hard fork a node operator could front-run delegated staking deposits using 0xB0-prefixed builder withdrawal credentials so the user's validator never appears and the deposit is credited to a builder with the same public key, urging staking protocols to adopt pre-deposit checks.
current_state.en: Lido's engineering lead warned that during Ethereum's Glamsterdam hard fork a node operator could front-run delegated staking deposits using 0xB0-prefixed builder withdrawal credentials so the user's validator never appears and the deposit is credited to a builder with the same public key, urging staking protocols to adopt pre-deposit checks.
